title: Norwegian Ice Service chart · European Arctic
analyst_note: The files contained in this data set were produced at the Norwegian Ice Service and derived from remote sensed data, and observations.  SSM/I, MODIS, AMSR-E, AVHRR, Envisat ASAR, and RADARSAT-2 sensors comprised the majority of the sensors used in the analysis.  The charts contain information pertaining to the concentration of sea ice in European sector of the Arctic Ocean and its marginal sea.

provenance.honesty: Polygon areas are computed from the chart geometry (equirectangular shoelace, floored at each ring's mean latitude) — no pixel inference. Concentration is the chart's CT attribute, not an ORBIT estimate. Rings are thinned for display only.
